en: Colorized historic postcard showing a tall stone medieval tower with a green domed roof and open lantern, standing in the middle of a cobbled square. On the tower's façade is a relief sculpture of a mounted figure, the König-Albert monument. Surrounding the tower are multi‑storey buildings with shops at street level and additional church or tower spires visible in the background. The sky is lightly clouded and the whole scene has an early 20th‑century hand‑tinted look. Printed German text at the top identifies the location.
